translation: Ah… I just remembered…

What's going on, Mikuru? Why'd you stop all of
a sudden?

Earlier, I brought everyone in the computer
society tea, but…
You did? To the computer society?
Yes. U-um, with Nagato.
Everyone was very pleased.
Yuki as well?! Why?!
Eh? Wh-what do you mean… "why”?
Because you're our attractive mascot girl.
So you mustn't do anything rash.

And to have Yuki with you as well—that's
major overkill.
It's wasted on them.
I'll have to have a word with Yuki as well.

U-umm… All Nagato did was push the button on
the kettle…

I feel like I get it, somehow. She just calmly
pushed the button, right?
Yes. That's truly all she did.

That's still enough to be overkill! You should
charge extra for that!

They're just an ordinary computer society
you know.
I'll have to thoroughly instruct you later.

Eek, this conversation went in a weird
direction…
